purpose: Retrospective descriptive price reference for SZSE risk-warning ordinary A shares; not a tradable portfolio, causal test or prediction
membership: Apply all reviewed effective-date changes to the dated anchor; require exact equality with each complete historical report's ST-marked A-share set and reconcile the endpoint with the separately dated exchange list
source_selection: SZSE is selected because complete unfiltered historical reports exist; no source or threshold selected using reference returns
return_basis: Official closing price / official previous-close reference - 1 for members with a valid trade; arithmetic mean across observed members of that day
reference_path: Compound those daily observed-sample means; rebase the first window close to 100 when comparing with other price references
coverage_basis: Valid trading observations / all reconstructed members, including suspended members in the denominator
missingness: Never fill nontrading or absent observations with zero; retain missing symbols. If any day fails the fixed coverage gate, publish no shortened reference path or window return
exit_basis: Remove a stock from the risk-warning category on its documented delisting-period or listing-end effective day; do not assign a zero payoff or infer old-shareholder wealth
limitations: Only SZSE; not a combined SSE/SZSE ST index
Historical prices and notices were first obtained after the represented dates; no historical point-in-time availability is claimed
The daily observed-sample basket can change, so its compounded path is a descriptive price reference and not portfolio wealth or total return
The recent window is a known stress case; this does not evaluate node-versus-market effectiveness or calibrate risk weights
